description.narrative: The project "Women's Financial and Economic Empowerment for Gender-Transformative Rural Development" is implemented by the Irish League of Credit Unions Foundation (ILCUF) in Ethiopia, Rwanda and Tanzania. The project works to increase women smallholder farmers' access to finance through rural savings and credit cooperatives (RuSACCOs), by strengthening the governance and capacity of RuSACCOs and their national, regional, and district-level regulatory bodies, providing financial literacy training to credit union members, and supporting the development of gender-inclusive policies and financial products targeted to meet the needs of women farmers. The project is linked to IFAD's flagship rural development programmes in the three countries, with a particular focus on the dairy sector in Rwanda and Tanzania. By supporting women's economic empowerment in the agricultural sector in these three countries, the project will contribute to improved household food and nutrition security, increased gender equality, and increased climate resilience in vulnerable rural communities.
